reason: Independent harness review before assessment found missing native point/metadata validation and insufficient separation of engineering failures from statistical withholding. Development smoke also found CSV float coercion, physical/stored count confusion and absent Mata q0-status handling. Original development attempts remain preserved.
point_mcse: Request mcse(all), the ordinary production diagnostic, and export its availability, mode and centering convention separately from inference metadata.

native_point_gate.reference: Independent dense exact point on the same realized working outcome
native_point_gate.authority: Existing development_acceptance_v1.json randomized equivalence policy; exact reference has zero numerical MCSE. No post-result relaxation.

transport: Import numeric CSV as double; validate e(N_stored) separately from e(N_physical); exact Mata highrank has no target-local q0 status matrix and successful calls imply status zero.
failure_classification: Interpreter/process/unknown/native structural or solver errors block the pipeline. Only explicitly enumerated maintained statistical withholding is counted as a scientific unavailable result. Atomic failures must agree across all four target rows; target codes and endpoint missingness must match their current route/reference schema.
mean_approximation_screen: Apply the already registered exact Gaussian discrepancy RMS/actual SD screen and expose q1 conditional-remainder discrepancy in reports. No new asymptotic claim is inferred.
variance_model_precision: The primary variance is in the intended exact-design leverage-rank span. Native regressors use estimated JLA leverage and target ranks, so this does not assert exact specification in every realized numerical basis.
estimated_offset_diagnostic: Add independent within-match weighted-zero-mean contrasts so first-stage controls genuinely have estimation error. Build each realized dense point reference from independently estimated WLS controls held fixed for the FE-only oracle; known-offset Gaussian covariance remains diagnostic, not the exact unconditional law.
